baseline.scope: the installed model as users run it today, on the same rows

baseline_behind_new_guards.scope: the same weights with this release's two refusals applied, reported so the weights and the guards can be told apart

evidence_scope: synthetic wrong-layout renderings of frozen CC0 corpus tokens, shaped as the engine hands them over; the gate families contributed no character to any count; the lexical track is lowercased and therefore harsher than real typing

superseded_by.detail: The rule demanded that the candidate not regress against the installed model on the gate families. Measured: the installed model counted 6,237 of those sequences, including the single token this run reported as a false conversion (`Uub`, the chemical symbol for ununbium), while the candidate counted none of them. The comparison asked one model about text it had memorised and the other about text it had never seen. The test split leans the other way by a similar margin - 7.8% of its evaluations are sequences the candidate learned from the lexicons. The decision moved to the intersection, where neither model counted the sequence: there the candidate gives no false conversion, the same as the installed model, at 98.63% recall against 95.18%. The two larger populations are still measured and now carry absolute ceilings instead of a comparison neither of them can support.
superseded_by.reason: the gate could not arbitrate between the two models
